content:
So, I just submitted my first Palomar formalization and the result was "Verification failure". If I got something misconfigured, I'm very happy to adjust it (or delete the submission and start again); but I'm unsure what went wrong.

The verification process seems to have hung at "Fail the run when verification did not pass", with the following error, something about a read-only file system:

Error: Verification or report delivery did not complete successfully
"/home/runner/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.35.0-rc3/bin/lake build failed (1): stderr:
info: mathlib: remote URL changed
  old: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git
  new: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4
info: stderr:
error: could not lock config file .git/config: Read-only file system
fatal: could not set 'remote.origin.url' to 'https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4'
error: external command 'git' exited with code 128"
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
PS: The failed verification run is here : https://github.com/PalomarRegistry/PalomarSubmission/actions/runs/38260305744

PPS: ChatGPT found a convincing diagnosis: it seems that my project's lakefile gives Mathlib as a dependency at URL https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git (with .git suffix), but it also depends on Tau Ceti, whose lakefile refers to mathlib via the same url without the .git suffix. This discrepancy doesn't seem to matter when running lake build locally, but apparently puzzled Palomar's verification scripts. New version of the submission is now running (& has been going for 25 minutes, while the other one failed almost instantly).
It's now been stalled waiting for the review for about an hour, despite the little message "Recent reviews have taken about 3 minutes" (!)
Post review build it can take upto 1 hours for rendering and another 1 hour for registration on an avg and worst case 6 hours for rendering and 6 hour for registration
